overview.description: The BWM Quality Growth ETF (BWQG) is an exchange-traded fund that mostly invests in large cap equity. The fund is an actively managed ETF that invests primarily in US large-cap companies with above-average long-term growth potential. The fund emphasizes high-quality businesses with durable competitive advantages and attractive valuations. BWQG was launched on Jul 8, 2026 and is issued by BWM.

holdings.infoBox: BWQG is an equity ETF with a total of 35 individual holdings. The top holdings are NVIDIA stock at 10.21%, Meta Platforms at 7.47%, Micron Technology at 7.07%, Invesco S&P 500 Equal Weight ETF at 6.80%, and Amazon.com at 6.28%.
